name: Octo Attack

features.name: Ink Stains
features.description: Mark every position that has held a win during the spin.

features.name: Tenta-Grab
features.description: Copies one symbol into every stained position.

review:
Otto the Octopus and his Tenta-Grab. Winning symbols vanish and new ones drop in, but each winning spot gets marked with an Ink Stain. When the Eye of Otto lands, he grabs one random symbol and copies it into every stain – and his own spot.

Wilds can carry 1x to 10x multipliers, so Otto copying a wild across all the stains is the dream. Stains reset between spins, so the cascade itself builds the setup. 10,000x max.
